supported_scope.input: One read-only relational snapshot, its Original DD and one natural-language request
supported_scope.output: One typed Case notion with at most one Case assignment per physical occurrence
unsupported: multiple Case assignments for the same occurrence

Complete event delivery is bounded by the registered input budgets
Native validation was a small development panel using shared Haiku construction
Final evaluation and independent Activity Equivalence adjudication are separate decisions
